purpose: Answer the open question whether avito/item needs the same price unification as search/page/filter (D-020).

catalogSide.note: The catalog decoder returns the bonus price from iva.PriceStep; the flat item.priceDetailed is the base 46999.

conclusion: avito/item already returns the visible bonus price: it decodes formattedPrice.string (46 882), not the base formattedPrice.value / item.price (46 999). The number matches both the catalog row and the number the item page prints large, so no price migration is needed. The microdata attribute itemprop=price carries the base price, so a schema.org read would be the wrong carrier.
residualRisks: item.js falls back to the numeric rawItem.price when formattedPrice.string has no digits; that fallback returns the base price, i.e. different semantics, silently.

The DOM fallback strips every non-digit from the whole #bx_item-price-value container. On this listing the container held exactly one number, but a layout that renders the struck old price inside the same container would concatenate both into a garbage number.
